gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-saurashtra: Cheerful and loud, Luckiest Guy pours out thick, marker-like letters that all sit at one width, while Noto Sans Saurashtra stays quiet beneath. Its capitals barely rise above the lowercase.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-sc: Loud, bouncy, and drawn like a marker. Luckiest Guy shouts at the top, and Noto Sans SC picks up below with chalky curves that stop before they close, giving the page room to breathe.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-sharada: Chunky ribbon letters, all one width, with an e that opens wide. Luckiest Guy takes the lead, and Noto Sans Sharada follows with bulky, open forms; a smaller body size lets the heading dominate.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-siddham: Fat marker lines with a grin. Luckiest Guy keeps its stroke constant everywhere, while Noto Sans Siddham offers a generous central band and an s with ends hanging loose. Pages of it would read friendly and easy.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Poured-ink fun, loud and cheerful. Luckiest Guy has tubelike lines of constant weight, while Noto Sans Sunuwar leaves daylight in its curves and keeps its ascender stems short. A long page of it would read lightly.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-syloti-nag: Luckiest Guy ends every stroke at the same measured thickness, giving it a loud, cheerful, poured-ink look. And Noto Sans Syloti Nagri answers with short ascenders and an a whose lower bowl opens to breathe.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Bent steel rod, but loud and happy. Luckiest Guy sets a bold stage up top, and Noto Sans Syriac follows with big, blown-glass bowls and s shapes that turn in wide, easy arcs.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-syriac-eas: Steady as a drafting pen yet cheerful and loud, Luckiest Guy owns the big, attention-grabbing lines. Noto Sans Syriac Eastern handles the quieter work, with lowercase that towers over its small caps.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Cheerful from the first letter, Luckiest Guy keeps its line width constant through every turn. Noto Sans Tai Viet then reads easily across a stretch, with short ascenders and terminals pulled back from each curve.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-tamil-supp: Luckiest Guy bends its lines like a straw into loud, cheerful letters, grabbing attention at once. Noto Sans Tamil Supplement does the steady work, with round parenthesis-like forms.
